test_case.purpose: For every required WAFL/TWIX endpoint, validate authoritative errortype1 stimuli at both source-defined locations, exact UCE attribution and the approved containment/reset branch with full fabric recovery between locations.
required_package: Errortype1 and errorlocation0/1 semantics plus corrected severity labels

test_case.test_command: Do not substitute a link or inject. After approval, enumerate and bind one exact physical path, capture raw state/log baseline, execute one authorized location once under OOB capture, correlate fresh UCE and containment/reset, restore/health-check the link and traffic, then separately authorize the other location.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved location produces the signed UCE source and deterministic containment/reset response; durable evidence is fresh and location-specific; host, link and fabric traffic recover within deadlines and all settings return to baseline before the next checkpoint.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until severity and tuple semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic WAFL text, guessed/first link, duplicate location, wrong source, stale record, unexpected reset, degraded fabric or incomplete restoration fails.

One mapped location once; second forbidden until complete recovery and evidence closure.
